11 OD trends to 2027

Top 7 OD trends in Indonesia, next to global reports.

TrendOD.ID survey 2025–26Global reports 2025–27
Analytics & data
49%run people analytics; analytics & data is the #1 needed skill (46%)
70%of employers rank analytical thinking an essential core skill (#1) WEF Future of Jobs 2025
AI in people work
64.8%are involved in data, digital or AI work
65%of executives expect 11–30% of their workforce to be redeployed or reskilled due to AI within two years Mercer GTT 2026
Change at speed
52%run change management; resistance is OD's #2 challenge (19%)
30%of leaders rate their digital agility high, while 75% say they must become more digital Mercer GTT 2026
Flatter structures & org design
90%do structure design; org design is the #1 project theme (29%)
98%of executives plan org design changes within two years Mercer GTT 2026
Skills-based talent
79%do job analysis; 57% competency work
63%of C-suite support skills-powered talent practices Mercer GTT 2026
Engagement & wellbeing
41%run culture and engagement work
20%of employees worldwide were engaged in 2025; thriving fell from 66% to 44% Gallup 2026 · Mercer 2026
Proving business impact
37%say business impact matters, as a challenge or as a needed skill
~⅓of organisations can measure people-programme impact HR.com 2025–26
